newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak April retail sales rise 8.0 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Slovak April retail sales rise 8.0 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Slovak real retail sales rose 8.0 percent year-on-year in April, compared with an annual increase of 7.1 percent in March, the Slovak Statistical Bureau (SUSR) said on Thursday.
In April 1996, retail sales contracted a real 1.6 percent percent year-on-year.
SUSR said in a statement retail sales totalled 101.6 billion crowns for the January-April 1997 period, an increase of 6.9 percent year-on-year.
The statement did not disclose any further details.
